critique.evidence: The section is visually cohesive and demo-ready across all three viewports: strong headline scale, disciplined cyan/amber/crimson accents, crisp borders, and clear hierarchy from summary through evidence card to CTA. Mobile stacking is especially well resolved. Deductions: the desktop header’s oversized ghost lettering is awkwardly clipped, tablet/mobile navigation visibly truncates items, several micro-labels and footer lines are extremely small and low-contrast, and the mobile header loses the brand wordmark and red-mode action. Automated contrast checks for header links were also incomplete, so their legibility is not fully proven.
critique.fix: Refine the responsive header: remove or intentionally contain the clipped ghost title, preserve a compact brand identifier and red-mode affordance on mobile, and make horizontal-nav truncation feel deliberate. Increase the smallest label/footer text and verify contrast on the muted navigation links.
